verses.pali: “Idhāhaṁ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṁ itthiṁ uppakkaṁ okiliniṁ okiriniṁ vehāsaṁ gacchantiṁ.
verses.english: “Just now, reverend, as I was descending from Vulture’s Peak Mountain I saw a scorched woman, sooty and sweaty, flying through the air,

verses.pali: esā, bhikkhave, itthī kaliṅgassa rañño aggamahesī ahosi.
verses.english: “That woman used to be the king of Kaliṅga’s chief queen.
She was of jealous nature, and poured a brazier of hot coals over her co-wife. …” …
